parameters.help_en: The ID of the Ray job
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The prefix that the keys of the returned files must start with
parameters.help_zh: 限定返回文件的 Key 必须以 Prefix 作为前缀
parameters.name: prefix

parameters.help_en: The marker after which the returned objects are listed in alphabetical order
parameters.help_zh: 设定从 marker 之后按字母排序开始返回 Object
parameters.name: marker

parameters.help_en: The character used to group object names. All objects whose names contain the specified prefix and between which the delimiter character appears for the first time are grouped as a set of elements (CommonPrefixes)
parameters.help_zh: 对 Object 名字进行分组的字符。所有 Object 名字包含指定的前缀，第一次出现 Delimiter 字符之间的 Object 作为一组元素（即 CommonPrefixes）
parameters.name: delimiter

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of objects to return. If the listing cannot be completed in a single request due to the max-keys setting, a NextMarker element is included in the response as the marker for the next listing request.

Valid values: greater than 0 and less than 1000.

Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh:
指定返回 Object 的最大数。 如果因为 max-keys 的设定无法一次完成列举，返回结果会附加 NextMarker 元素作为下一次列举的 marker。
取值：大于 0 小于 1000
默认值：100
parameters.name: max_keys
